group_rule: Frozen postmin32_pointwise_label; k1 own position-SE ellipse contact; no probability filter or weighting
total_rule: Both endpoints in same group, true original adjacent frames, keep exact zero cross-frame distances
background_rule: Ordered same-frame pairs within group, remove ALL exact zero distances including self and coincident points
normalization_rule: Independently normalize pooled Total and B raw counts to unit mass on 0-3 um; no frame-wise normalization or frame equal-weighting
beta_rule: Tail least squares dot(T,B)/dot(B,B), clipped [0,1]; save raw beta
shape_rule: Signed Intra divided by signed area on all 300 bins; retain negative bins; abs(area)<=0.01 unavailable
background_compatibility_rule: Descriptive normalized tail L1/cosine and tail-bin residuals; does not validate dynamic-mask background exchangeability

bootstrap.method: Reuse identical saved paired nonoverlapping-block weights within each 250-frame stratum
bootstrap.boundary_rule: Sum only source-block-internal true adjacent pairs; never create adjacency at block joins
bootstrap.interval_interpretation: Exploratory pointwise 2.5-97.5 percentile ranges; temporal bootstrap coverage not calibrated; no p values or simultaneous-significance claims; conditional on fixed masks and labels; does not propagate segmentation/registration uncertainty

mask_agreement_title: ROI IoU between consecutive 1s support blocks
mask_diagnostic_footer: Masks are fixed within50frames. Block-boundary IoU is descriptive; background exchangeability is unvalidated.
